summary: The agenda lists updates on Methuen Day, the Santa Parade, and the Superintendent Search. It also includes officer nominations and a potential member update.

PUBLIC MEETING NOTICE
Notice is hereby given that the Methuen Commission
on Disability will hold its next meeting on:
November 12th, 2026
Methuen City Hall, 7:00 p.m.
Searles  Building- 41 Pleasant Street Methuen in the  Great Hall
      *This is a change of date from November 5th *
AGENDA
1) Call to Order, Attendance  & Approval of Agenda
2) Approval of the  Minutes  from the last meeting
3) Public Participation- maximum  time 5 minutes
4) Treasurer’s Report
5) ADA Coordinator’s Report and recent See  Click Fix reports
6) Update from DPW  on  accessibility issues  in the city
7) Old Business
 Methuen Day Update
 Santa Parade
 Superintendent Search
.
8) New Business
 Nomination of officer positions
 Upcoming year
 Potential member update
Any other business for the Good and Welfare of the community including individuals with a disability. 
Adjournment
Accessibility Notice: Anyone needing access  to accommodation to participate in City of Methuen programs  or
services, please contact Deputy DPW Director Felix Garcia, ADA Coordinator, at 978-983-8545 or 
fgarcia@methuen.gov at least 2 weeks in advance, or 2 business days before any Board or Commission meeting. 
This notice is available in alternative formats upon request.
